Horticulture vs. agriculture?
Scale, diversity, perishability, intensity; same biology, different economics
What limits photosynthesis in most crops?
Light (below saturation), CO₂, temperature; water and nutrients at extremes
Why does pruning make plants bushier?
Removes apical dominance (auxin source) → lateral buds released
What is VPD and why does it matter?
Vapor pressure deficit = driving force for transpiration; managed in CEA
What is the production chain order?
Propagation → Growing → Harvest → Post-harvest → Market
Why are chilling hours important?
Many temperate fruit trees need cold exposure to break endodormancy before they will flower
What's the per-acre value of horticulture vs. field crops?
5–100x higher for intensive horticulture; compensates for high labor/input cost
